summary: GCL Global Holdings Ltd, a Cayman Islands holding company listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, announcing a board-authorized share repurchase program of up to $10 million of ordinary shares over 12 months. The program allows open-market purchases, private negotiations, or other means, subject to Rule 10b-18 limitations, and may be modified or suspended at any time. Funding will come from available cash. The press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1. This is a discretionary capital return with no obligation to repurchase specific amounts. Watch for actual repurchase activity and potential price support, though no fixed terms or commitments were provided.
